scope: Current official source-rights evidence, cache scope, retention, withdrawal and admission decision

verified_facts.data_license: CC0 1.0 Universal; public domain and not copyrighted
verified_facts.attribution: USDA requests that FoodData Central be listed as the data source
verified_facts.api_key: Required for API requests and must remain server-side
verified_facts.default_rate_limit: 1000 requests per hour per IP; excess returns HTTP 429

scope_limitations: This applies to FoodData Central data, not arbitrary third-party pages, images, trademarks, or user-submitted content
CC0 does not validate food identity, preparation, brand equivalence, nutrient basis, or adapter compatibility
A reviewed item-specific FDC source policy and existing server-side authority checks remain required
sources.decision: Data-rights evidence supports considering FDC records for reviewed use; no production policy or registry entry is approved by this audit

verified_facts.tavily_output_retention: Official help states Search/Extract/Crawl output may be retained long-term without a maximum retention period or Tavily deletion requirement
verified_facts.end_user_display: Official help permits displaying Tavily results and derived content in an application, subject to third-party rights
verified_facts.publisher_rights: Tavily does not grant rights to third-party content in results; the customer remains responsible for each publisher's rights and terms
verified_facts.cross_customer_cache: Official help directs customers to contact Tavily before sharing cached results across multiple customers
verified_facts.standard_terms_scope: Current Platform Terms describe the API grant as use for the customer's internal business purposes; the customer's actual order form or separate agreement was not inspected
verified_facts.ai_output: AI-generated output should be reviewed for accuracy and not represented as human-generated

scope_limitations: Tavily's permission to retain its output does not authorize copying, displaying, or reusing the publisher's underlying nutrition table
No specific publisher page, website terms, content license, attribution rule, or automated-access permission was approved in this audit
The user's Tavily account plan, order form, and any written support confirmation were not inspected
Do not enable cross-user Tavily cache until the applicable plan and intended application scope are confirmed
sources.decision: Keep Tavily-derived nutrition sources outside the production registry pending publisher-specific rights and account/application-scope confirmation

verified_facts.existing_review_status: Review-only in source-rights-audit.json; this audit did not re-review the current dataset notice

scope_limitations: Dataset license and TFDA website or individual-page terms must not be conflated
No new source-page or retention policy was approved

source_artifacts_without_withdrawal_purg: nutrition_profiles and immutable source policy versions
nutrition_profile_cache rows beyond ordinary TTL cleanup
nutrition_fdc_profile_previews, including profile, portion and source block until physically removed
nutrition_scan_contexts, candidate snapshots and confirmation records after expiry/revocation
nutrition_enrichment_requests, including durable request and result payloads
current_retention_implementation.raw_extraction_storage: Tavily raw Markdown is consumed by the retrieval/adapter/model path; no dedicated raw-page table was identified. Normalized profiles and selected source-row evidence can persist in request results, profiles, previews or cache, so downstream copies are not assumed exempt from publisher terms.
current_retention_implementation.backup_scope: A future purge contract must account for SQLite backups and WAL/journal copies, not only live table rows

admission_decision.decision: Remain fail-closed. FDC data rights may support a separate reviewed policy for a specific FDC record, but no global or production registry admission is made. Tavily and TFDA remain blocked for web-derived nutrition reuse.
next_requirements: Record a server-approved, item-specific FDC policy only after its identity and nutrient adapter review; keep user and cross-user cache scope explicit
Confirm the Tavily account/order-form and intended application scope; request written confirmation before shared multi-user caching
Review each publisher's applicable content license, attribution, automated access and derived-data rules before using its nutrition page
For any source requiring deletion, implement idempotent source-scoped purge across dependent tables and backups or exclude that source
